title: KestrelCare Facility Payment Terms: Diagnostic Time
content:
**Clause 1.** On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan whose coverage level pays diagnostic time when the resulting repair is covered, the diagnostic time paid on an approved repair order is one hour at the plan's labor rate cap.

**Clause 2.** The diagnostic time payment is the payable diagnostic hours times the diagnostic hourly rate, rounded to the cent, and never above the coverage remaining on the plan.

**Clause 3.** On a coverage level that does not pay diagnostic time, the diagnostic time payment is nothing.

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Payable hours | one hour |
| Hourly rate | the labor rate cap of the plan's coverage level |
| Coverage remaining | the plan's coverage remaining when the payment is made |
| Whether diagnostic time is paid | the plan's coverage level |

## Worked figures (hypothetical plans)

| Labor rate cap | Coverage remaining | Payment |
|---|---|---|
| 150.00 | 9800.00 | 150.00 (1 hour at 150.00) |
| 160.00 | 92.40 | 92.40 (held to the coverage remaining) |
| level that does not pay diagnostic time | any | 0.00 |
